cells.gaps: No legal mandate is held; the all-digital claim covers income tax and GST filers.
cells.note: In August 2025 the NRA Commissioner General said all income tax and GST filers file digitally on ITAS and there is no more manual filing (SLE-006, SLE-004), so half or more of returns are filed online. Payment through ITAS by mobile money (SLE-002) meets the rung below.
